cs.t: Hifiman Ananda wired headphones. They are the lightest and clearest headphones I've ever used. I was fed up with the unreliable connection and dying battery in my Airpods Max. Listening to music is now effortless, and I'm listening more closely than ever to all genres. I keep them on a wooden stand on my desk, plugged into an Apogee Duet 3 interface.
cs.th: Ask HN: What work/office purchase transformed your life?
